segments.text:
V. 7.
Wo to the world becauſe of offences—That is, unſpeakable Miſery will be in the world thro' them▪
for it muſt needs be that offences come—Such is the Nature of Things, and ſuch the Weakneſs, Folly, and Wickedneſs of Mankind, that it cannot be but they will come: but wo to that man—That is, miſerable is that Man, by whom the offence cometh. Offences are, all Things whereby any one is turned out of, or hindered in the Way of God.
